index:ix_import_jobs_file_hash: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_import_jobs_file_hash ON import_jobs (file_hash)
index:uq_timepoint_experiment_dag: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_timepoint_experiment_dag ON measurement_timepoints (experiment_id, day_after_germination)
table:alembic_version: CREATE TABLE alembic_version (CONSTRAINT alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num), version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
table:audit_logs: CREATE TABLE audit_logs ("after" JSON, "before" JSON, FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), action VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, entity_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, entity_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(36))
table:experiment_materials: CREATE TABLE "experiment_materials" (CONSTRAINT ck_material_display_order CHECK (display_order >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_material_experiment_number CHECK (experiment_number IS NULL OR experiment_number > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_material_replicates_override CHECK (replicate_count_override IS NULL OR replicate_count_override > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_material_samples_override CHECK (sample_count_override IS NULL OR sample_count_override > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_material_seeds_override CHECK (seeds_per_dish_override IS NULL OR seeds_per_dish_override > 0), CONSTRAINT uq_material_experiment_lot UNIQUE (experiment_id, seed_lot_id), CONSTRAINT uq_material_experiment_number UNIQUE (experiment_id, experiment_number), FOREIGN KEY(experiment_id) REFERENCES experiments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(seed_lot_id) REFERENCES seed_lots (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (id), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, display_order INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, experiment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, experiment_number INTEGER, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(120), replicate_count_override INTEGER, sample_count_override INTEGER, seed_lot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, seeds_per_dish_override INTEGER)
table:experiment_protocols: CREATE TABLE "experiment_protocols" (CONSTRAINT ck_protocol_observation_period CHECK (observation_period_days IS NULL OR observation_period_days > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_protocol_replicate_count CHECK (replicate_count IS NULL OR replicate_count > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_protocol_sample_count CHECK (sample_count IS NULL OR sample_count > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_protocol_sample_scope CHECK (sample_scope IS NULL OR sample_scope IN ('per_dish', 'per_material')), CONSTRAINT ck_protocol_seeds_per_dish CHECK (seeds_per_dish IS NULL OR seeds_per_dish > 0), FOREIGN KEY(experiment_id) REFERENCES experiments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (experiment_id), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, experiment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, germination_criterion TEXT, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, observation_period_days INTEGER, replicate_count INTEGER, sample_count INTEGER, sample_scope VARCHAR(30), sampling_rule VARCHAR(40), seeds_per_dish INTEGER, summary TEXT)
table:experiments: CREATE TABLE "experiments" (CONSTRAINT ck_experiment_status CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'ready', 'active', 'completed', 'cancelled')), CONSTRAINT fk_experiment_owner FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (code), code VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, description TEXT, ended_at DATETIME, experiment_type VARCHAR(8) DEFAULT 'GER' NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_experiment_type CHECK (experiment_type IN ('GER')), id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, numbering_locked_at DATETIME, owner_id VARCHAR(36), planned_start_date DATE, started_at DATETIME, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, termination_reason TEXT)
table:germination_dishes: CREATE TABLE "germination_dishes" (CONSTRAINT ck_dish_replicate_no CHECK (replicate_no > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_dish_seed_count CHECK (seed_count > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_dish_sown_or_cancelled CHECK (sown_at IS NULL OR cancelled_at IS NULL), CONSTRAINT uq_dish_code UNIQUE (code), CONSTRAINT uq_dish_label UNIQUE (material_id, label), CONSTRAINT uq_dish_material_replicate UNIQUE (material_id, replicate_no), FOREIGN KEY(material_id) REFERENCES experiment_materials (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (id), cancel_reason TEXT, cancelled_at DATETIME, code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, material_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, replicate_no INTEGER NOT NULL, seed_count INTEGER NOT NULL, sown_at DATETIME)
table:germination_observations: CREATE TABLE germination_observations (CONSTRAINT ck_observation_count CHECK (new_germinated_count >= 0), CONSTRAINT uq_observation_time UNIQUE (dish_id, observed_at), FOREIGN KEY(dish_id) REFERENCES germination_dishes (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (id), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, dish_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, new_germinated_count INTEGER NOT NULL, notes TEXT, observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL)
table:import_jobs: CREATE TABLE import_jobs (FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, error_message TEXT, file_hash VARCHAR(64), filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, successful_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, total_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(36))
table:measurement_timepoints: CREATE TABLE "measurement_timepoints" (CONSTRAINT ck_timepoint_dag_nonnegative CHECK (day_after_germination >= 0), FOREIGN KEY(experiment_id) REFERENCES experiments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (id), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, day_after_germination INTEGER NOT NULL, experiment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(80))
table:seed_lots: CREATE TABLE seed_lots (CONSTRAINT ck_seed_lot_quantity CHECK (quantity IS NULL OR quantity >= 0), FOREIGN KEY(taxon_id) REFERENCES taxa (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (code), code VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, collected_at DATETIME, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, notes TEXT, quantity INTEGER, source VARCHAR(255), source_code VARCHAR(120), taxon_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL)
table:seedling_measurements: CREATE TABLE "seedling_measurements" (CONSTRAINT ck_root_resolved CHECK ((root_length_mm IS NOT NULL AND root_length_mm >= 0 AND root_unavailable = 0) OR (root_length_mm IS NULL AND root_unavailable = 1)), CONSTRAINT ck_shoot_resolved CHECK ((shoot_length_mm IS NOT NULL AND shoot_length_mm >= 0 AND shoot_unavailable = 0) OR (shoot_length_mm IS NULL AND shoot_unavailable = 1)), CONSTRAINT uq_sample_timepoint UNIQUE (sample_id, timepoint_id), FOREIGN KEY(sample_id) REFERENCES seedling_samples (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(timepoint_id) REFERENCES measurement_timepoints (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (id), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, measured_at DATETIME NOT NULL, notes TEXT, root_length_mm NUMERIC(10, 2), root_unavailable BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, sample_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, shoot_length_mm NUMERIC(10, 2), shoot_unavailable BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, timepoint_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL)
table:seedling_samples: CREATE TABLE "seedling_samples" (CONSTRAINT ck_sample_number CHECK (sample_number > 0), CONSTRAINT fk_sample_source_observation FOREIGN KEY(source_observation_id) REFERENCES germination_observations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT uq_sample_number UNIQUE (dish_id, sample_number), FOREIGN KEY(dish_id) REFERENCES germination_dishes (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY (id), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, dish_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, germinated_at DATETIME, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, position_label VARCHAR(80), sample_number INTEGER NOT NULL, source_observation_id VARCHAR(36))
table:sessions: CREATE TABLE sessions (FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (token_hash), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, csrf_token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL)
table:taxa: CREATE TABLE taxa (PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (code), UNIQUE (scientific_name), code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, common_name VARCHAR(255), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, family VARCHAR(255), genus VARCHAR(255), id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, life_form VARCHAR(255), notes TEXT, scientific_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL)
table:users: CREATE TABLE users (PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (username), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, is_admin BOOLEAN NOT NULL, must_change_password BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, username VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL)
